name: Letta
description: Open-source framework for stateful agents, formerly MemGPT.
descriptionZh: 面向有状态 Agent 的开源框架，前身为 MemGPT。
keyFact: Letta is the open-source stateful-agent framework renamed from MemGPT in September 2024; MemGPT originated as a paper (arXiv:2310.08560) from the UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab and Letta Inc. is led by its original authors.
keyFactZh: Letta 是 2024 年 9 月由 MemGPT 更名而来的开源有状态 Agent 框架；MemGPT 源自 UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab 的论文（arXiv:2310.08560），Letta Inc. 由其原始作者领导。
